instruction: A clean studio photograph captured in a high-angle full shot. In a minimalist white studio with a seamless white floor, the woman in the white outfit (R2) on the left lunges forward, extending her arms toward the woman in the black outfit (R1) on the right. The woman in the black outfit (R1) stands in a defensive, crouched stance, raising her hands to block or parry the incoming movement. Both barefoot dancers are engaged in a tense, martial-arts-inspired contemporary dance interaction. Bright, even studio lighting casts soft, subtle shadows on the clean white floor.
